scripts.db:migrate:students: npx wrangler d1 execute students-db --remote --file=./migrations/0001_create_students.sql && npx wrangler d1 execute students-db --remote --file=./migrations/0002_add_classes.sql
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm run db:migrate:students && pnpm run db:migrate:interview
scripts.db:migrate:local:students: npx wrangler d1 execute students-db --local --file=./migrations/0001_create_students.sql && npx wrangler d1 execute students-db --local --file=./migrations/0002_add_classes.sql
scripts.db:migrate:local: pnpm run db:migrate:local:students && pnpm run db:migrate:local:interview
scripts.db:reset:students: npx wrangler d1 execute students-db --remote --command="DROP TABLE IF EXISTS classes; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS students;" && pnpm run db:migrate:students
scripts.db:reset:interview: npx wrangler d1 execute interview-db --remote --command="DROP TABLE IF EXISTS interview_questions; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS interview_categories;" && pnpm run db:migrate:interview
scripts.db:reset: pnpm run db:reset:students && pnpm run db:reset:interview
scripts.deploy: next build && npx wrangler pages deploy .next
